purpose: Correct troop anatomy and weapon mechanics while preserving role colors and tier equipment progression. T4 Crossbowmen and T5 Snipers carry actual crossbows.
raw_sources: Local retained source directory, configurable with --source-dir in tools/build-character-art-repairs-v3.py. Not needed at runtime.
derivative_method: Crop generated alpha bounds >8; common uniform scaling into original v2 canvas and optical bounds; WebP quality90 UI/86thumb; no repainting or recoloring. Guardian files copied byte-for-byte from v2.
